title: Friction log — weekly serving sync (IZU)
body:
Purpose: quick-ish weekly sync focused on 'frictions' — recurring small problems that accumulate cost/latency or cause interrupts. Use this as a rolling log; each meeting we triage, assign, and timebox follow-ups.

Proposed run: 30 min (10m metrics + 15m friction triage + 5m action recap)

Quick metrics (top-three signals)
- p50/p95 token latency (last 7d): p50 42ms, p95 198ms (note spike Tue 03/10)
- Failed requests (>5xx) rate: 0.45% (target <0.2%)
- Autoscale cold-starts per hour: 3.2 (target <1)

New frictions (to surface)
1) Cold starts during scheduled canary rollout — logs show k8s evictions correlated with node drain. (report: JIRA-RT-4823)
2) Console route filter dropdown stutters when >20k routes (UI throttling). UX ticket created by Console team.
3) Small-model quantization mismatch causing minor token drift on MQA-3 (repro on testset-2026-02)

Recurring frictions
A) Batching backpressure on long-tail sequence lengths — suspect misconfigured queue limits; mitigation candidate: dynamic batch cap per model.
B) Confusion on model variant routing when capacity degraded: product docs ambiguous; incidents show devs fallback to global default instead of cost-optimized model.

Triage plan (owners & timeboxes)
- Cold starts / node-eviction: owner Diego Torres | 2-day blitz (investigate k8s eviction metrics + bump pod disruption budget) | interim: canary rollouts paused if >2 cold starts/hour
- Console dropdown stutter: owner Maya Li | 5day fix (debounce + virtualized list) | interim: add text note for large teams
- Quantization drift: owner Arjun Patel | reproduce and roll regression test (3 days) | interim: pin MQA-3 rollback config
- Batching backpressure: owner Izumi Nakamura | prototype adaptive queue limits (7 days)
- Routing docs: owner Product (linked) | doc patch + 1-hour walkthrough (owner: Priya) | due EoW

Action items (recap)
- Diego: collect node eviction timestamps and correlate with canary schedules, share raw CSV in #serve-ops by 2026-03-14
- Maya: open frontend PR for virtualized route list + perf test, link to CONFLUENCE-serve-performance-notes; due 2026-03-18
- Arjun: add MQA-3 testset regression + example prompt file to repo; open PR; due 2026-03-16
- Izumi: draft proposal for dynamic batch cap and run small-scale experiment on dev cluster; due 2026-03-20
- Priya (product): update routing docs + schedule 30m sync; done by 2026-03-17

Notes to self
- Consider a 'friction severity' simple rubric (impact x frequency) to prioritize next meeting
- Bring sample logs for cold-starts (tail latencies) — saves time during triage

Parking lot
- Look into an automated experiment to compare quantization profiles' behavioral drift
- Consider quarterly 'friction retro' with cross-team reps

Next meeting prep
- Everyone: paste brief one-line update on assigned action in this doc before meeting
- Metrics owner (Arjun): provide p50/p95 trend chart (embedded link ok) by Fri end

Quick links
- Incident JIRA: JIRA-RT-4823
- Frontend PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/587
